metaTitle: Hasdrubal Ucebḥan d Hasdrubal Barca — sin At Barca yesɛan yiwen yisem
metaDesc: Hasdrubal Ucebḥan, win yezwejen akked yelli-s n Hamilcar, win i d-yesnulfan Carthagène yerna yeḵteb amtawa n Èbre (226), d Hasdrubal Barca, gma-s n Hannibal, i yezgren Idurar n Alpes yemmuten di Métaure (207).
title: Hasdrubal
lede: Sin seg At Barca sɛan yisem-agi, yeɛni s tutlayt tapunikt « Baal d talwit-iw ». Win yezwejen akked yelli-s n Hamilcar yebna Hispania tapunikt ; mmi-s issay ad yezwir ɣer Hannibal di Italya. Sin lmuqadderat, snat tmetwanin iweɛṛen.
heroAlt: Ṛebɛa n ssekka n At Barca yettwaxedmen di Hispania
heroCap: Ssekka n At Barca n Hispania : aqerruy s tjeǧǧigt (Melqart neɣ yiwen seg At Barca ?) akked lfil
who.beau.k: Win yezwejen akked yelli-s n Hamilcar · † 221
who.beau.name: Hasdrubal Ucebḥan
who.beau.d: Win i d-yeddan deffir Hamilcar di Hispania (229/228–221), win i d-yesnulfan Carthagène, win i yeḵtaben amtawa n Èbre, yettwanɣa di 221.
who.barca.name: Hasdrubal Barca
who.barca.d: Gma-s amecṭuḥ n Hannibal, iṭṭef Hispania ɛecra iseggasen, yezger ula d netța Idurar n Alpes, yemmut di Métaure di 207.
note: Ur t-nemsliɣ ara akked Hasdrubal Giscon, acengu n Scipion di Hispania akked Tefriqt, neɣ akked Hasdrubal Aqayed Aneggaru, aneggaru i yeḥman Qarṭaǧ di 146.
beau.alt: Lebqayed n lesswaṛ apunik n Carthagène
beau.cap: Lesswaṛ apunik n Carthagène, « Tamdint Tamaynut » i d-yesnulfan Hasdrubal.
beau.name: Hasdrubal Ucebḥan
beau.epithet: Win yezwejen akked yelli-s n Hamilcar, win i d-yesnulfan Carthagène
beau.lede: Amdakel n umennuɣ, yezwej akked yelli-s n Hamilcar, iweṛt di 229/228 Hispania mazal-itt teṭṭef kra. Anda baba n tmeṭṭut-is yesseɣli amennuɣ, nețța iḥekkem s tdukla, s zzwaǧ d tasnulfa n temdint tamanaɣt.
beau.stats.1.t: tasnulfa n Qart Hadasht, ara d-yilin d Carthagène
beau.stats.3.t: d leɛmer n Hannibal asmi t-yečna lɛesker deffir tmettant n Hamilcar
beau.rows.0.d: Yeddan d baba n tmeṭṭut-is ɣer Hispania, ɣer tama n Hannibal amecṭuḥ, yuɣal d amɛawen-ines agejdan.
beau.rows.1.d: Deffir tmettant n Hamilcar zdat Héliké, lɛesker yečna-t d aqayed ; Qarṭaǧ teqbel. Yerra lḥeqq n Hamilcar ɣef Orissi, yesseɣli temdinin-nsen.
beau.rows.2.d: Yesnulfa-d ɣef webeḥri igerrzen « Tamdint Tamaynut », Carthagène, tamanaɣt n Hispania n At Barca, teqrib i tɣerwa n lfeṣṣa.
beau.rows.3.d: Tuggditen, Ṛuma tazen-d imceggɛen : Hasdrubal yeqbel ur yezgir ara Èbre s lsilaḥ. Unzul n tigzirt yettwaqbel s tidet d amḍiq apunik.
beau.rows.4.d: Yettwanɣa deg uxxam-is sɣur yiwen Ikelti (aklan akken i d-yeqqaṛ Tite-Live) i yeqheṛen ɣef bab-is i yettwanɣan. Lɛesker yečna Hannibal.
beau.themes.0.p.0: Akken i d-yeqqaṛ Tite-Live, Hasdrubal issali tazmert tapunikt « s laḥya n yigelliden d teddukla n yiqayden ugar n umennuɣ ». Diodore yeqqaṛ-d yezweǧ yelli-s n ugellid aybiri yerna igduden ibiriyen semman-t d aqayed ameqqran.
beau.themes.0.p.1: Tarrayt-agi tesseǧhed aṭṭef n Hamilcar : tiddukla, iḥebsen, lɛesker n uḥraz d lxraj gan seg unzul n tigzirt amḍiq n At Barca s tidet.
beau.themes.1.p.0: Yiwen n yisem akked Qarṭaǧ s yiman-is : Qart Hadasht. Tamdint-agi tezga ɣef tigzirt yeqqnen s ugelmim, s yiwen seg yibeḥriyen ifazen n Lebḥer Alemmas Alɣarbi. Polybe iḥka-tt-id s telqayt, yebder-d taɣalt anda yella uxxam n Hasdrubal.
beau.themes.1.p.1: Larsenal, agerruj, axxam n ssekka akked webeḥri n umennuɣ, tuɣal d lqaɛa anda ara d-yeddu Hannibal di 218 — d lmeqsud ara yeṭṭef Scipion di 209.
beau.feature.p.0: Tuggad seg Yigaliyen di Ugafa n Italya, Ṛuma teqbel kan : Iqarṭaǧiyen ur zegren ara Èbre s lsilaḥ. I Polybe, d ayagi i d akk agbur n umtawa.
beau.feature.p.1: Tamdint n Sagonte, deg unzul n wasif, tamdakelt n Ṛuma, ur telli ara deg umtawa akken i d-yeqqaṛ Polybe ; Tite-Live yeqqaṛ s wayen yemgaraden belli tettwaḥadar. Lexyal-agi ad yuɣal d sebba n umennuɣ apunik wis sin asmi Hannibal yessiddi Sagonte di 219.
beau.feature.cap: Tiyatru aṛumi n Carthagène : tamdint n Hasdrubal teqqim d yiwen seg yibeḥriyen imeqqranen n Spania.
beau.voices.0.q: « Issali tazmert tapunikt s laḥya n yigelliden d usali n yiqayden ɣer tama-s ugar n umennuɣ d lsilaḥ. »
beau.voices.1.q: « Iqarṭaǧiyen ur zegren ara Èbre s lsilaḥ. »
beau.voices.1.cite: Tamsalt n umtawa n 226, akken i d-yeqqaṛ Polybe, Imezruyen, II, 13
beau.voices.2.q: Yettwaṭṭef yettwaɛteb, win yenɣan yeqqim s udem yecban win yeḍsan, yeɣleb lhemm.
beau.legacy.d: War Carthagène, idrimen-is d tdukla-ines tibiriyin, abrid n Hannibal ɣer Italya ur yezmir ara ad yili. Hasdrubal Ucebḥan ibeddel aṭṭef n umennuɣ ɣer tmurt yebnan — yerna tamdint-is, Cartagena, teqqim tettawi isem n Qarṭaǧ.
barca.cap: Aɣeẓdis n Trasimène, anda Hannibal yenɛem di 217 : Italya i ur yezmir ara ad yaweḍ ɣer-s gma-s.
barca.name: Hasdrubal Barca
barca.epithet: Gma-s i yezgren Idurar n Alpes akken ad yaweḍ ɣer Hannibal
barca.lede: Aqayed n lebɣi uzzalen, iṭṭef amennuɣ n Hispania ɛecra iseggasen asmi gma-s yesnuɣ Italya. Syen yuɣal s webrid n Idurar n Alpes akken ad as-yawi anɛam — yerna ur yewwiḍ ara.
barca.stats.0.t: n umennuɣ di Hispania (218 – 208) zdat Scipion
barca.stats.1.t: n lɛesker n Qarṭaǧ i yezgren Idurar n Alpes, di 207
barca.stats.2.t: n yiɛsekriyen ifazen i d-yewwi lqunsul Néron s lexdeɛ n webrid
barca.stats.3.t: n Iqarṭaǧiyen d yimddukal-nsen yemmuten di Métaure akken i d-yeqqaṛ Polybe (56 000 akken i d-yeqqaṛ Tite-Live)
barca.rows.0.d: Mmi-s wis sin n Hamilcar Barca, yettwarbba am watmaten-is deg iqamen n Hispania.
barca.rows.1.d: Hannibal yeddu ɣer Italya yefka-yas Hispania : lbabuṛat akked ca n 12 650 iɛsekriyen n uḍar, 2 550 lfursan d 21 lfil (Polybe, III, 33).
barca.rows.3.d: Asmi iheggi ad yaweḍ ɣer Hannibal, yettwanneɣ qrib i Èbre sɣur watmaten Scipion.
barca.rows.4.d: Akked gma-s Magon d Hasdrubal Giscon, yesseɣli lɛesker iṛumaniyen : Publius d Cnaeus Scipion ttwanɣan.
barca.rows.5.d: Yettwazger sɣur Claudius Néron, isefham-as belli ad iffeɣ, yeqqim kra n lweqt yerna yeffeɣ deg yiḍ akked lɛesker-is (Tite-Live, XXVI, 17).
barca.rows.6.d: Yettwanneɣ sɣur Scipion (win ara d-yilin d Afriqan), yesellek tazmert n lɛesker-is, agerruj-is akked lfyal-is, yeddu ɣer Gaule.
barca.rows.7.d: Deg tafsut, yezger Idurar n Alpes azgen uɣẓiq ugar n gma-s, qeblen-t igduden n Alpes, syen yessiddi war lfayda Plaisance.
barca.rows.8.d: Imceggɛen-is ttwaṭṭfen ; Néron yezwir s tuffra ɣer lqunsul-nniḍen, Livius Salinator. Yettwaṭṭef deg lkamin ɣef Métaure, Hasdrubal yeqheṛ yemmut deg umennuɣ.
barca.themesTitle: Aḥraz n Hispania, awiḍ ɣer Italya
barca.themes.0.p.0: Asmi umezruy iteddu ɣef Hannibal, Hasdrubal yella d yiwen seg wid i isɛan tazmert n Qarṭaǧ. Iḥekkem ɣef Ibérie ɛecra iseggasen, iṭṭef tɣerwa n lfeṣṣa d lxedma i yeččaten tanaẓi n umennuɣ apunik.
barca.themes.0.p.1: Zdat ssiɣ n llejyunat n Scipion, iḥrez imukan ipunikiyen, iṭṭef lɛerucat ibiriyen s tdiblumasit d tezmert, yerna di 211 yenɛem di nnig n Bétis.
barca.themes.1.t: Tazgart Tis Snat n Idurar n Alpes
barca.themes.1.p.0: Yedda deffir n lǧreɛ n gma-s, yeffeɣ Hispania deffir Baecula, yeqqim di Gaule armi d tafsut, yezger Idurar n Alpes di tafsut n 207 — s telqayt i d-yesbegnen belli tigawt n Hannibal mačči d lbaraka kan.
barca.themes.1.p.1: Abrid-is d tidet war ma yettwassen ; Tite-Live yeqqaṛ kan belli yufa izirig ldin yergazen n yidurar talwan. Yessiddi syen Plaisance, war lfayda, yesṛuḥ lweqt iqimen.
barca.feature.p.0: Hasdrubal yazen i Hannibal, deg unzul n Italya, lfursan i d-yewwin tabrat i d-yesbedden amkan n temlilit deg Ombrie. Ttwaṭṭfen. Lqunsul Claudius Néron yeǧǧa lɛesker-is zdat Hannibal, yezwir ɣer ugafa s lexdeɛ n webrid akked 7 000 iɛsekriyen ifazen akken ad yaweḍ ɣer Livius Salinator.
barca.feature.p.1: Mi yesla i nnfir yesɛeddan snat tikkal deg lɛesker aṛumi, Hasdrubal yefhem-d belli sin iqunsulen ddukklen. Issay ad yeffeɣ deg yiḍ, imeẓriyen-is ǧǧan-t, yettwaṭṭef ɣef rrif n Métaure. Mi iwala amennuɣ yeɣli, yejleb ɣer wammas n ugraw aṛumi yemmut s ssif deg ufus-is.
barca.feature.p.2: Néron isseɣli-d aqerruy-is zdat imukan n Hannibal. Tigawt-agi n lxiyanet yettwaxemmemen tebɣa ad teṛẓ lhemm n ucengu ameqqran n Ṛuma.
barca.feature.alt: Ṛebɛa n ssekka n At Barca
barca.feature.cap: Ssekka n At Barca n Hispania : idrimen i d-yewwi Hasdrubal ɣer Italya deffir Baecula.
barca.voices.0.q: « Teɣli, teɣli, akk usirem d ssɛaya n yisem-nneɣ, seg wasmi yemmut Hasdrubal. »
barca.voices.0.cite: Hannibal, akken i d-yeqqaṛ Horace, Odes, IV, 4
barca.voices.1.q: Mi iwala aqerruy n gma-s, Hannibal yeqqaṛ-as belli iwala dinna lmuqadder n Qarṭaǧ.
barca.voices.2.q: Skud yella usirem, iḥrez iman-is i yiɛsekriyen-is ; mi kullec yeɣli, inadi tamettant deg umennuɣ, am mmi-s n Hamilcar i yella.
barca.voices.2.cite: Akken i d-yeqqaṛ Polybe, Imezruyen, XI, 2
barca.legacy.d: Métaure d amḍiq i deg ibeddel umennuɣ apunik wis sin : Hannibal, war tiwtilin, yeqqim di Bruttium ; Hispania a d-teɣli ger ifassen n Scipion aseggas i d-iteddun. Hasdrubal Barca yeqqim d gma-s yettwasfeden, win tmettant-is teqqen abrid ɣer Ṛuma.
